market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially flat today, with NASDAQ down 0.2% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, reflecting a lack of strong catalysts in either direction. Without major economic data releases or earnings surprises driving sentiment, stocks consolidated near recent levels. This kind of quiet, range-bound session is common between major news events.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日主要指數走勢大致持平，納指下跌0.2%，標普500下跌0.3%，反映市場缺乏明顯的方向性催化劑。由於沒有重大經濟數據或業績意外左右市場情緒，股市在近期水平附近整固。這種淡靜、區間震盪的走勢在重大消息事件之間頗為常見。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means checking multiple technical signals together — like RSI, MACD, and price relative to moving averages — before buying, rather than relying on just one indicator. When several signals line up in the same bullish direction, it suggests stronger, more reliable buying interest rather than random noise.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在買入前同時檢查多個技術指標——例如RSI、MACD和股價相對於移動平均線的位置——而不是只依賴單一指標。當多個訊號同時指向同一個看漲方向時，代表買盤力量較強、較可靠，而非隨機波動。
